instruction: Candid wide-angle photograph from a high angle showing an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the man in the black cap and dark polo shirt (R1) stands facing right. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands with her back to the camera, extending her right arm to touch the man's (R1) chest. Overhead fluorescent lights illuminate the room, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
